deep_read.description: Interpreter (Arabic) IOM - International Organization for Migration Kavala Both national and international UG - Ungraded level Speaks Arabic, Greek, English Application deadline: November 21, 2026 (11 days) Apply Summary by Impactpool The IOM is seeking a UG Interpreter (Arabic) to support the integration of beneficiaries of international protection into Greek society. The role involves providing interpretation and translation services, assisting with cultural mediation, and maintaining relationships with beneficiaries and stakeholders. The successful candidate will also manage project-related communications and assist in various project activities. This position is part of the 'Helios+' project aimed at enhancing employability and social inclusion for third-country nationals. Candidate Requirements: High school degree/certificate Minimum one year of relevant work experience Fluency in English and Greek Fluency in Arabic Computer literacy Strong work ethics Valid driver's license (advantage) Experience in a multi-cultural environment (preferred) Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations, and as the leading UN agency in the field of migration, works closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners. IOM is dedicated to promoting humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It does so by providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to ensuring a workplace where all employees can thrive professionally, while working towards harnessing the full potential of migration. Read more about IOM's workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Internal and external candidates will be considered for this vacancy. For the purposes of this vacancy, internal candidates are defined as staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded or ungraded contract, including Junior Professional Officers (JPOs), staff on Special Leave Without Pay (SLWOP), UN Volunteers with at least twelve (12) months of continuous service in IOM, and staff members on secondment/loan released by the Organization, unless otherwise specified in their contract. Staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded contract will not retain their contract type if appointed to an ungraded position.
